decisions.why: Juzo Inspiration, Juzo Soft, Juzo Adventure, Juzo Move are medical compression garments for lymphedema and venous insufficiency
Juzopro Malleo products are ankle-foot orthoses; Juzopro Patella Xtec is a knee orthosis, covering ankle and knee bracing
Juzoflex Malleo Xtra products are ankle supports; Juzoflex Achill Xtra is an Achilles/calf support, covering ankle and calf bracing
